title: decision: git backend uses SHA-1 OIDs with documented upgrade path
description: In post/git_store.rs, the git backend uses SHA-1 object IDs internally (libgit2 does not expose SHA-256 format in its public Rust API). CIDs (external keys) are SHA-256 based; the git OID is an implementation detail stored in a SQLite index. The module comment documents this limitation and the upgrade path. The design is correct for now.
